card.name: Punctuation before a confidence interval
card.fires_on: A comma or opening parenthesis right after a risk or hazard ratio value, just before "95% CI" or "95% confidence interval" is given.

modes.label: Comma after ratio

modes.label: Parenthesis after ratio
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a hazard ratio or relative risk, introducing the interval.
